LanguageData.CC_Pnl_HideTip: Hide this panel. Bring it back with a right-click on the panels' button by the play settings (bottom right).
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_OptionsTip: This panel's options: what it shows, whom it lists, its size and background.
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_OpacityTip: The panel's background. Click to make it fainter; at its faintest, the next click makes it full again.
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_CompactTip: Compact: the same, in less room.
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_ResetPositions: Put the panels back in their places
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_ButtonTip: On-screen panels: the colonists' moods, the mood trend, the colony's vitals, the council at a glance, the alerts, health, and work and idle.\n\nClick to show or hide them. Right-click for each panel, the hover card, and arranging them.
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_EditHint: Drag each panel by its top bar; it snaps to the edges and to the others.
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_MoreLinesTip: The panel shows only so many rows and keeps what matters most. Click to show them all; "Rows before 'and more'" in its options sets the limit again.
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_MoreTip: Not everyone fits, so the board keeps those most at risk; no one in trouble is ever left off. Click for the Moods page, or allow more rows in the panel's options.
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_OpenPage: Open {0}'s page in the council window
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_RowClick: Click to go to them. Shift-click for their Mood tab. Right-click for more.
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_SortRiskTip: Most at risk first. Click for the colonist bar's order.
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_SortBarTip: In the colonist bar's order. Click for the most at risk first.
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_TrendEmpty: Collecting: the first points come after an hour.
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_TrendTip: The colony's average mood (gold) and its lowest colonist's (orange), taken once an hour. The dashed line is where minor breaks begin for most people (35%).\n\nHover the graph for the values at a point. Click for the Moods page.
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_DaysTip: Click to show the last {0} days.
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_FoodTip: About {0} days of food at the colony's rate: meals and raw food people can eat, counted as the advisor counts it. Orange under {1} days, red under {2} (Rimfolk's settings).
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_MedicineTip: {0} medicine on the map and with the colonists. The advisor likes two for each colonist ({1}).
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_PowerTip: The grid makes {0} W more than it uses (less, when the number is negative). {1} Wd stored in batteries.
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_ClickOverlay: Click to show or hide the temperature overlay.
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_RaidTip: The last big threat came {0} days ago.
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_NoResearchTip: Nothing is being researched, though there is something to research.
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_ClickLetter: Click to open the most pressing letter.
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_TrustTip: The colonists' trust in the council, on average: {0}.
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_AlertsUnreadable: The game's alerts can't be read here.
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_MoreAlertsTip: Not every alert fits, so the panel keeps the most urgent; critical ones always show. Allow more rows in its options to see them all.
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_HideAlert: Hide this alert in the panel
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_A_NoneHidden: No alerts are hidden in this panel. Right-click an alert's row to hide it here.
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_HideGameAlerts: Hide the game's own alert list
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_ShowGameAlerts: Show the game's own alert list too
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_SortPriority: By priority, in the game's own order
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_H_LosingTip: losing: at this pace it wins before immunity does
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_H_Opt_Summary_Tip: One faint line under each name with every condition and what matters most about it: "Cut 60% healed · Flu immunity 62% vs 40% · Lice untended".
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_H_Opt_Lines_Tip: A line for each condition under the name, with where it is, how well it was tended and when that wears off, how far it has healed and roughly when it's healed, or the immunity race as two small bars.
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_W_IdleTip: Idle for about {0} hours: nothing they may do needs doing, or they can't reach it.
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_W_Click: Click to go to them. Right-click for the panel's menu.
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_W_CycleClick: Click to go to each of them in turn.
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_W_UnmannedClick: No one able to do it has it switched on. Click for the Work tab.
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_W_WhyFire: a fire in the home area
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_W_WhyCut: plants are marked to cut or harvest
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_W_WhyHandle: animals are marked to tame or slaughter
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_W_WhyWarden: there are prisoners to look after
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_W_WhyHaul: things lie waiting to be hauled
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_C_BelowMajor: Mood {0}, under the major break line ({1})
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_C_Falling: Falling towards a break: heading for {0}, the line is {1}
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_C_Close: Mood {0}, close to the break line ({1})
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_Opt_Compact_moods: Thin bars with initials in a grid, like raid frames.
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_Opt_Compact_trend: The graph alone, without the line under it.
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_Opt_Compact_vitals: Icons and values only, two to a row.
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_Opt_Compact_council: Icons and values only, two to a row.
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_Opt_Compact_alerts: Tighter rows in small text, a narrower panel.
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_Opt_Compact_health: One line each: the name and what matters most.
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_Opt_Compact_work: Names, marks and the need bars, without what they're doing.
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_Opt_Compact_inventory: Tighter rows and smaller tiles in a narrower panel.
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_Who_WithPrisoners: Colonists everywhere, and the colony's prisoners
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_Part_number: The mood and where it's heading
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_Part_drag: What drags their mood down most
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_Part_icons: Marks: a break, strain, a wish, wavering certainty
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_Part_count: How many things an alert is about
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_Part_facts: Show details: tended or not, how far along, the time left
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_Part_change: The change since this time yesterday
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_Part_zero: Items at zero (with what ran out since yesterday)
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_Part_colony: Who is idle, who needs food or sleep
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_Opt_RowsTip: When there are more, the panel keeps what matters most and says how many it left out. Critical rows always show. At 0 every row shows.
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_Opt_Reset: This panel as Rimfolk ships it
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_ResetConfirm: Put every on-screen panel and the hover card back as Rimfolk ships them: their places, sizes and options?
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_SettingsButtonTip: {0}: what it shows, its order and size (shown now: {1}).
LanguageData.CC_Settings_HudShown_Tip: Small panels on the map beside the game's own: the mood board, the mood trend, the colony's vitals, the council at a glance, the alerts, health, work and idle, and the inventory. They sit beneath the game's own interface, so nothing of the game's is ever covered. Show or hide them all with the button by the play settings (bottom right), or with a key you pick in Options, Keyboard, Rimfolk.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_HudShown: Moods, vitals, the council, alerts, health, work and the stock on the map; move them by their top bar.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_HudPanelOptions: Rows and columns, order, whom it lists, rows before "and more", size and background.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_HudPanelOptions2: The alerts, health, work and idle, and the inventory.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_HudHideGameResources: Hide the game's own resource list while the Inventory panel shows
LanguageData.CC_Settings_HudHideGameResources_Tip: The Inventory panel shows the same counts as the game's list down the left, so that list steps aside while the panel is up. The counting goes on as always; with the panel hidden, switched off, or on the world map, the game's list is back.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_HudHideGameResources: The Inventory panel instead of the game's resource list; the list comes back whenever the panel is gone.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_HudHideGameAlerts: Hide the game's own alert list while the Alerts panel shows
LanguageData.CC_Settings_HudHideGameAlerts_Tip: The Alerts panel shows every alert the game has, so the game's own list on the right steps aside while it's up. The alerts keep updating as always; with the panel hidden, switched off, or on the world map, the game's list is back.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_HudHideGameAlerts: The Alerts panel instead of the game's list; the list comes back whenever the panel is gone.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_HudLock_Tip: The panels can't be dragged by accident. "Arrange the panels" in their menu still moves them.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_HudLock: The panels stay where they are; "Arrange the panels" still moves them.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_HudHideWithTabs_Tip: The panels always sit beneath the game's windows and its own readouts, so a window simply covers them. With this on, they also go away while a big window is open, such as the Work or Research tab or the council window. Small ones like the build menu leave them be.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_HudHideWithTabs: Off: they stay, beneath the window. On: gone while the Work tab, Research or the council window is open.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_HudHideOnWorld: Hide them on the world map
LanguageData.CC_Settings_HudHideOnWorld_Tip: The panels show on the colony's map only, not while the world map is up.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_HudHideOnWorld: Only on the colony's map, not on the world map.
LanguageData.CC_SetTip_HudTheme: The panels' background. Each panel's own background setting makes it fainter still.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_HudTheme_Dark: A dark background a little see-through, like the game's own readouts.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_HudTheme_Darker: Nearly solid, for busy maps and bright snow.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_HudTheme_Clear: Mostly see-through, with no border until the mouse is on a panel.
LanguageData.CC_SetTip_HudFont: The panels' text. Each panel's size setting scales it further.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_HudFont_Small: Tiny text throughout: the panels at their smallest.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_HudFont_Normal: Names and values in the game's usual text size, easier to read.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_HudMoodMargin: At risk within {0} of the break line
LanguageData.CC_Settings_HudMoodMargin_Tip: Someone this close above their own minor break line counts as at risk: orange on the board, first in its order, and on the hover card.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_HudMoodMargin: How close above their own break line someone turns orange on the board and the card.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_HudFoodWarn: The vitals' food line turns orange with less food than this.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_HudFoodBad: And red with less than this; four days is where the advisor calls food low.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_HudReset: Put the panels and the hover card back as shipped
LanguageData.CC_Settings_HudReset_Tip: Their places, sizes and options, and the switches under "On-screen panels" and "Hover card", as Rimfolk ships them.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_HudReset: Everything under "On-screen panels" and "Hover card" back to how it started.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_HoverCard_Tip: Rest the mouse on a colonist on the map and, after a moment, a small card shows what matters most about them now: their mood and break lines, the two or three most pressing things, and what they're doing. It stays out of the game's way: not while dragging, placing, targeting, or over a window.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_HoverCard: Rest the mouse on a colonist: their mood and what matters most right now.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_HoverDelay: How long the mouse rests on someone before their card shows.
LanguageData.CC_SetTip_HoverModifier: Show the card only while this key is held, so it never shows by itself.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_HoverKey_None: The card shows whenever the mouse rests on someone.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_HoverKey_Alt: The card shows only while Alt is held.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_HoverKey_Shift: The card shows only while Shift is held.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_HoverKey_Ctrl: The card shows only while Ctrl is held.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_HoverWho_Everyone: The colony's free colonists, its slaves and its prisoners.
LanguageData.CC_SetTip_HoverPlace: Beside the mouse, or always in the same corner.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_HoverPlace_Cursor: Beside the mouse, never under it.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_HoverPlace_Corner: Bottom left, above the inspect pane.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_HoverMood_Tip: The mood bar with their own break lines and a mark where their mood is heading.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_HoverMood: The mood bar with their break lines and where it's heading.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_HoverConcerns_Tip: The most pressing things about them, most urgent first: bleeding or a condition that can kill, a mental break or the break line, hunger and exhaustion, strain, a wish waiting, wavering certainty, and the biggest moods dragging them down with what would help.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_HoverConcerns: Bleeding, a break, hunger, strain, a wish, the biggest moods dragging them down.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_HoverLines: Anything critical always shows, even beyond this.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_HoverDoing_Tip: Their current job, in the game's words.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_HoverDoing: Their current job, in the game's words.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_HoverHideGameTip: Hide the game's tooltip for that pawn
LanguageData.CC_Settings_HoverHideGameTip_Tip: While the card shows for someone, the game's own small tooltip for them (name, weapon, health) stays away so it doesn't cover the card. Everyone else's tooltips are left alone.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_HoverHideGameTip: The game's own tooltip for them steps aside while their card shows.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_HoverScale: Bigger for large screens, smaller to keep more of the map in view.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_HoverOpacity: Fainter to see the map through it.
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_I_FoldTip: Click to fold this away; its total stays.
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_I_UnfoldTip: Click to see what's in it.
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_I_NoChange: The same as this time yesterday.
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_I_ChangeSoon: The change since yesterday shows once the panel has watched the stock for a day.
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_I_NonePinned: Nothing is pinned. Right-click an item to pin it to the top.
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_I_ShowGameList: Show the game's own resource list too
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_I_HideGameList: Hide the game's own resource list
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_I_Style_classic_Tip: Like the game's own list: each item's icon and count, one to a line. Hover for its name.
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_I_Style_grouped_Tip: By the game's categories (food, manufactured, raw resources, items, weapons, apparel...), each a header with its total that folds away with a click.
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_I_Style_grid_Tip: Tiles with the icon and the count under it, wrapping after as many as you like: a strip along an edge of the screen.
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_I_Style_essentials_Tip: Only what most colonies watch, large and calm: meals and the days of food, medicine, silver, steel, components, wood, and what you pin.
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_I_Sort_Category: By category, as the game lists them
LanguageData.CC_Pnl_I_Sort_Change: The biggest change since yesterday first
